Google Drive sync — setup guide
One-time setup · jobs then sync across all devices automatically

Jobs currently save to this browser only. Follow these steps once to sync across all devices and Google accounts:

  1. Go to console.cloud.google.com → sign in → create a new project (name it anything)
  2. APIs & Services → Library → search “Google Drive API” → Enable
  3. APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen → External → App name: “GreenGenUK Hub” → save and continue through all steps
  4. On the Scopes screen → Add Scope → search drive.appdata → add it → Save
  5. Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application
  6. Under Authorised JavaScript origins add the URL you open this app from
    e.g. https://yourdomain.com — or host on GitHub Pages for free
  7. Click Create → copy the Client ID (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com)
  8. Open this HTML file in any text editor → find YOUR_CLIENT_ID_HERE → replace with your Client ID → save
  9. Reopen the file → click Connect Google Drive in the sidebar → sign in with Google
🔒 Your jobs are stored only in your own Google Drive private app folder. Nobody else can access them.
